request: mix: JSON配列をMarkdownの表に変換する / ファイルまたは標準入力から、オブジェクトのJSON配列またはNDJSONを読み、全キーの和集合を見出しにしたMarkdown表を標準出力に出す。キーがない行は空欄、入れ子の値は一行のJSON文字列にし、セル内の縦線は \| にエスケープする。例: [{"name":"a","n":1},{"name":"b","tag":[1,2]}] は name・n・tag の3列の表になり、tag列には [1,2] が入る。コマンド名は jsonmd

spec.name: jsonmd
spec.summary: jsonmd reads a JSON array of objects or NDJSON from a file or stdin and prints a Markdown table whose columns are the union of all keys.
behavior: B1: Input is the named file, or stdin when no argument is given. More than one argument or an unknown flag is a usage error: print 'usage: jsonmd [file]' to stderr, exit 2.

B2: If the first non-whitespace byte of the input is '[', the whole input must be one JSON array of objects, followed only by whitespace. Otherwise the input is NDJSON: a sequence of JSON objects separated by whitespace/newlines (blank lines ignored). Numbers keep their original text.
B3: Columns are the union of all keys in order of first appearance (objects in input order, keys in each object's order). If a key is duplicated within one object, the last value wins.

B4: Cell text: string as-is; number as its original text; true/false as 'true'/'false'; null and missing keys as empty; array/object as compact single-line JSON (no whitespace outside strings, original key order and number text kept).
B5: In every cell and header, each CR LF, LF or CR is replaced by one space, then each '|' is replaced by backslash + '|'. No other escaping.

B6: Output is the header row, the separator row, then one row per object. A row is '| ' + cells joined by ' | ' + ' |' + newline, so an empty cell gives two spaces between pipes. The separator row has '---' per column: '| --- | --- |'. Every line ends with a newline.
B7: Nothing is written to stdout unless the entire input parsed successfully.
B8: Invalid JSON: stderr 'jsonmd: invalid JSON: <detail>', exit 1. An array element or NDJSON value that is not an object: stderr 'jsonmd: element N is not an object' (N is 1-based), exit 1.
B9: Unreadable file: stderr 'jsonmd: <system error text>', exit 1.
B10: Empty or whitespace-only input, zero objects (e.g. []), or objects with no keys at all: stderr 'jsonmd: no data', exit 1.
